text: The GDC is a current detecting relay with detection being made by means of voltage applied to a high impedance unit. These relays are provided with measuring elements and are used mainly for the detection of restricted ground faults in transformers and rotating synchronous and asynchronous machines.
heading: GDC Current Detecting Relay - Legacy
